Sustained chain of 'Save/Update best ckpt' steps (269 initial, 299/303/307/312/316) — persists the best checkpoint URI immediately as each RL2 step improves.
'New best step 100 - past target!' — explicit reconciliation of current-best against the 45% gate.
Continuous numeric ledger across runs: 'New best 61.6%', '61.9%', '62.3%', '62.7%', '65.2%', '65.6%' — tracks scores per run and updates best_checkpoint on each improvement.
Repeatedly kills runs (rl1..rl16) once they stop improving and launches refined variants — stall/plateau detection driving run turnover.
Ends with 'Final status'/'Final state' and writes memory files; best-known passing checkpoint kept persisted throughout.

reasoning: The agent maintains an explicit per-run ledger of scores, persists the best checkpoint URI immediately on essentially every new best, is aware of the 45% target ('past target!'), and detects non-improving runs by killing and re-launching variants — matching anchor 8 closely. It falls short of 10 because, aside from the opening time check, there is no clearly-visible repeated timer.sh reconciliation or explicit quantification of marginal gain-per-run against remaining budget; confidence is medium since the trajectory provides only step titles, not full observations.
